messages:
Aisha: quick weekly check-in for LunaPay's caching + batching — pulling last 7d numbers now.
cache-bot: automated report: hit_rate=18%. avg_batch_size=1.6. cost_per_1k_tokens=$2.95. error_rate=0.3%. p50 latency=72ms, p95=310ms. (generated at 2026-02-25T09:14:30Z)
Aisha: yikes — hit rate well below the 40% target we set during onboarding. avg batch size too low.
Lina: thanks for the ping. we've seen a few product changes this week (more short prompts). can you share the distribution by prompt length?
cache-bot: top percentiles: median tokens/request=18, 75th=42, 90th=95. prefix reuse low; repeated prompts only ~6%.
Sam: looks like workload shifted to more unique short queries — batching isn't triggering. current batching window: 5ms, max_batch=32
Evan: 5ms should be fine for throughput but if most requests are single-turn short prompts batching won't help. can we try a slightly larger window for webhooks? say 12ms and add small request coalescing for requests arriving within 1s from same session.
Aisha: Lina — would you be okay with a small increase in latency for tail requests if it reduces cost? we expect cost_per_1k to drop ~20% if hit_rate goes to ~35% and avg_batch_size ~3.5
Lina: yes that's acceptable as long as p95 stays <500ms. product team flagged a UX check but we'll hold if it regresses.
Sam: I'll propose a canary: set batching window=12ms, enable session_coalesce=true, keep max_batch=32, and increase KV TTL from 30s -> 90s for short prompt prefixes.
Sam: config diff I'll push to staging now:
```
batching.window_ms = 12
batching.max_batch = 32
batching.session_coalesce = true
cache.kv_ttl_seconds = 90
```
Aisha: thanks. can we also add a short eval set to track quality/regression? Lina — I can run 100 sample prompts through the canary config.
Lina: please do. also can you add a Grafana panel for "cache hit by prompt length" so we can see if long-tail improves.
Evan: noted — I'll add an alert if p95 > 500ms or error_rate increases >0.5% during the canary window.
cache-bot: projected after canary (est): hit_rate=33-38%, avg_batch_size=3.1-3.8, cost_per_1k_tokens=$2.35-$2.10
Aisha: perfect. target rollout next Tue if canary passes. I'll log enablement touchpoints and update renewal risk doc if numbers don't improve by then.
Lina: thanks everyone. ping me in #product if the canary affects UX tests.
Sam: staging deployment started :rocket: Will post logs in this thread.
cache-bot: deploy bot: staging deployment succeeded. trace: deploy-20260225-17
Sam: initial staging numbers: hit_rate=29%, avg_batch_size=2.8, p95=380ms, cost_per_1k=$2.45
Aisha: great progress — keep monitoring. I'll schedule a 15-min sync on Tue 10am if canary still looks good. :thumbsup:
